input.objectiveText: Describe the size and weight of objects using words like longer, shorter, heavier, and lighter.
input.intent: Live direct instruction where the tutor shows two objects and asks the student to finish sentences aloud using the exact descriptive words: longer, shorter, heavier, or lighter.

data.title: Size and Weight Word Practice
data.description: Listen to the two objects and say out loud which word describes them.

items.ask: Here is a feather, and here is a brick. Is the feather longer, shorter, heavier, or lighter?
items.howToPlay: I will show you two things and say the words, and you say the one that fits.
items.acceptRule: Saying a close synonym or speaking the word clearly at the end of the phrase counts.
items.signatureError: Saying heavier or naming the object instead of the attribute is not correct.
items.correctionBody: A feather weighs less than a brick, so the feather is lighter.

items.ask: Here is a train, and here is a toy car. Is the train longer, shorter, heavier, or lighter?
items.howToPlay: I will show you two things and say the words, and you say the one that fits.
items.acceptRule: Saying the descriptive word clearly on its own counts as the answer.
items.signatureError: Saying shorter or naming the vehicle instead of the size word is not correct.
items.correctionBody: The train stretches out further than the toy car, so the train is longer.

items.ask: Here is a pencil, and here is a crayon. Is the crayon longer, shorter, heavier, or lighter?
items.howToPlay: I will show you two things and say the words, and you say the one that fits.
items.acceptRule: Saying the attribute clearly even if spoken in a full sentence counts as the answer.
items.signatureError: Saying longer or naming the tool instead of the size word is not correct.
items.correctionBody: The crayon does not stretch out as far as the pencil, so the crayon is shorter.

items.ask: Here is a bowling ball, and here is a tennis ball. Is the bowling ball longer, shorter, heavier, or lighter?
items.howToPlay: I will show you two things and say the words, and you say the one that fits.
items.acceptRule: Saying the weight word with emphasis counts as the correct answer.
items.signatureError: Saying lighter or naming the ball instead of the attribute is not correct.
items.correctionBody: The bowling ball pulls down with more weight than the tennis ball, so the bowling ball is heavier.

items.ask: Here is a pencil, and here is a school bus. Is the pencil longer, shorter, heavier, or lighter?
items.howToPlay: I will show you two things and say the words, and you say the one that fits.
items.acceptRule: Stating the correct comparison word even with a slight pause before it counts as the answer.
items.signatureError: Calling the pencil longer than a school bus mixes up the two objects.

items.ask: Here is an elephant, and here is a mouse. Is the elephant longer, shorter, heavier, or lighter?

items.acceptRule: Saying the correct weight word clearly at the end of the sentence counts as the answer.
items.signatureError: Calling an elephant lighter than a mouse confuses size and weight.
items.correctionBody: An elephant weighs a tremendous amount, so the elephant is heavier.

input.objectiveText: Explain the difference between size words like longer, shorter, heavier, and lighter using your own words
input.intent: Direct instruction spoken practice where the live tutor prompts the learner with simple scenarios (e.g., 'If a stick reaches further across the table, is it longer or heavier?') and the student answers aloud using the correct descriptive word.

data.title: Comparing Size and Weight
data.description: You will compare things out loud and tell us which word fits best.

items.ask: Here is a feather, and here is a rock. Is the rock longer, shorter, heavier, or lighter?
items.howToPlay: I will show you two things and say the words, and you say the one that fits.
items.acceptRule: Saying a close descriptive form or synonyms like 'much heavier' counts as the target word.
items.signatureError: Saying 'lighter' because the rock is small is the wrong attribute.
items.correctionBody: A heavy rock weighs more than a feather, so the rock is heavier.

items.ask: Here is a pencil, and here is a crayon. Is the pencil longer, shorter, heavier, or lighter?
items.howToPlay: I will show you two things and say the words, and you say the one that fits.
items.acceptRule: Describing the length measurement aloud before the final word still counts.
items.signatureError: Saying 'shorter' confuses the pencil with the smaller item.
items.correctionBody: A standard pencil extends further in length than a crayon, so the pencil is longer.

items.ask: Here is a leaf, and here is a tree branch. Is the leaf longer, shorter, heavier, or lighter?
items.howToPlay: I will show you two things and say the words, and you say the one that fits.
items.acceptRule: Saying 'it is shorter' counts as the correct answer.
items.signatureError: Saying 'longer' by mixing up the two objects is incorrect.
items.correctionBody: The leaf stretches less distance than the tree branch, so the leaf is shorter.

items.ask: Here is a metal key, and here is a fluffy pillow. Is the metal key longer, shorter, heavier, or lighter?
items.howToPlay: I will show you two things and say the words, and you say the one that fits.
items.acceptRule: Stating the answer with extra emphasis counts as correct.
items.signatureError: Saying 'heavier' because metal feels strong is a common size-weight mix-up.
items.correctionBody: Even though a pillow is big, a key weighs very little in your hand, so the key is lighter.
